blocks.text: Qudrati taur par paida hone wale particulate matter mein zameen ki satah ki dhool aur pollen, spores aur janwaron ke malbe jaisa hayatiyati madda shamil hai. Aatish-fishani phatne fiza mein gases aur particulate matter ki bohat bari miqdarein dal sakte hain, aur bijli ki kaundh nitrogen ke oxides ki khasi miqdar paida karti hai. Doosre qudrati zaraye samandar ki satah par algae hain, jo hydrogen sulfide kharij karti hai; hawa ka kataao, jo particulate matter lata hai; aur daldal, peat bogs aur kam gehri jheelein jaise nam ilaqe, jo methane paida karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Hawa ke pollutants ke teen bare qudrati zaraye pehchanein aur mukhtasar wazeh karein (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: Aatish-fishan sulfur gases, raakh aur dhool ki bari miqdarein nikalte hain; bijli ki kaundh hawa ko itna garam karti hai ke nitrogen aur oxygen mil kar nitrogen oxides banate hain; aur daldal jaise nam ilaqe paudon ke anaerobic galne se methane chhorte hain. Dhool ke toofan, pollen aur hydrogen sulfide dene wali samandari algae mazeed misalein hain.

items: Qudrati: dhool, pollen aur spores (PM); aatish-fishan (gases, PM); bijli ki kaundh (NOx); samandari algae (H2S); hawa ka kataao (PM); daldal aur bogs (CH4).
